prompts.title: Watercolor Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Convert the reference family into a heartwarming mixed-media family portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, blending photorealistic facial detail with elegant watercolor painting on textured off-white watercolor paper.
The portrait is captured at eye level with a slightly close-up perspective, showing a loving family of three in a close, intimate embrace. The child is centered between both parents, held securely and comfortably, smiling with joyful, open-mouthed laughter. The child wears light blue pajamas with small cartoon panda patterns.
The mother stands on the left, wearing a soft light-blue button-down shirt, with a gentle affectionate smile. The father stands on the right, wearing a dark black shirt and a golden wristwatch, smiling naturally with warmth and happiness. Both parents stay close to the child, with their heads gently near each other, creating a soft family-centered composition. Their arms naturally wrap around the child, showing love, protection, and emotional connection.
Render the faces, eyes, skin texture, hair, and clothing folds with high-definition realism. Keep the facial details photorealistic, while the outer edges of the figures softly dissolve into expressive watercolor washes, ink splashes, paint drips, and painterly brush textures.
Use muted earthy watercolor tones such as deep navy blue, soft slate blue, warm sepia brown, beige, and subtle olive green. The watercolor textures should bloom outward behind the family, creating an elegant artistic halo effect.
The background should be clean textured off-white watercolor paper with visible paper grain. Add delicate hand-drawn decorative details, including small sketch-style heart doodles and a subtle botanical leaf branch in the upper-right area. In the upper-left corner, add elegant handwritten calligraphy text: “Together is our favorite place to be.”
Lighting should be soft, diffused, and natural, with no harsh shadows. Maintain a warm, emotional, sentimental mood suitable for a premium family keepsake illustration or greeting card artwork.
Style: photorealistic watercolor portrait, mixed-media illustration, realistic faces, painterly edges, watercolor splash art, textured paper canvas, emotional family portrait, soft natural lighting, premium fine-art keepsake, high-detail digital painting.

prompts.title: Framed in Love
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality 3D stylized cartoon illustration based on submitted references of family members, all peeking out from behind a matte heart-shaped opening. Only their heads, hands (where applicable), and upper torsos should be visible, looking playful and hiding.
Subjects must be arranged in descending age order.
The composition should feature a soft, textured beige. The entire outer background is a beige gradient; the heart-shaped opening borders are the same colour but slightly darker; the inner background is a dark violet gradient, creating a contrast that highlights the brightness of the characters. The style must have a soft Pixar/Disney animation look, with large expressive eyes, smooth skin, and slightly enlarged head proportions for cinematic charm, while retaining the recognizable facial features, hairstyles, and age from the reference photos.
Everyone is gently holding the edges with small hands/paws and leaning slightly forward with curious, playful expressions. The lighting should be soft studio light with warm, gentle highlights and no harsh shadows.
The image must be a 1:1 aspect ratio portrait with centralized framing and shallow depth of field. The final render should be ultra-sharp 4K, in an Octane/Unreal/Disney rendering style.

prompts.title: Eternal Silhouette
prompts.prompt:
Use the provided reference images to match the identity, age, and facial features of both subjects. Preserve their natural facial structure, proportions, hairline, and overall likeness. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter their identities in any way. Ensure the silhouettes still reflect the correct face shape and recognizable profile of each subject.
Create a dramatic black-and-white high-contrast silhouette portrait of a couple standing extremely close to each other in an almost-kiss pose.
Composition & Framing
Vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.
Close-up framing from the chest or shoulders upward. The couple is centered in the frame, facing each other in profile.
Man (left side): Facing right. He has short, neatly styled hair and light stubble, wearing a formal blazer with a collared shirt. His head is slightly tilted downward toward the woman.
Woman (right side): Facing left. She has naturally long, wavy hair with a floral hairpiece positioned on the upper side of her head, small earrings, and an elegant outfit with subtle decorative details. Her head is slightly tilted upward toward the man.
Their noses are almost touching and their foreheads nearly meet. They maintain direct eye contact with each other, creating a romantic and intimate moment.
Lighting & Style
The couple appears as deep black silhouettes against a pure bright white backlit background. Strong rim lighting clearly defines the contours of their faces, hair, and bodies, creating a sharp separation between the subjects and the background.
The image should resemble professional cinematic studio silhouette photography with crisp edges, smooth gradients, and strong contrast. Render the image in high-contrast monochrome with high-key lighting and absolutely no color.
Typography
Place the text centered at the top of the image with clear spacing from the edge.
Title: “ENDLESS LOVE” in a large, elegant serif font.
Subtitle below the title:
“Loved you yesterday, love you still, always have, always will.”
Use a thin, spaced grey font for the subtitle.

prompts.title: Rose Day Romance
prompts.prompt:
Create a semi-realistic, high-quality digital illustration designed as a romantic Rose Day greeting.

The artwork should combine a soft painterly romantic aesthetic with clean, modern digital rendering, feeling warm, intimate, and celebratory—suitable for a premium Valentine’s greeting card or social media post.
REFERENCE & FACE MATCH (STRICT)
Use the uploaded reference images as age and strict identity locks for both subjects.
Preserve exactly:

Facial structure and bone anatomy
Natural skin tone and texture
Eye shape, spacing, and gaze direction
Nose, lips, jawline, and cheek proportions
Hairline, hairstyle, and natural hair density
❌ No beautification

❌ No facial stylization

❌ No age change

❌ No identity drift
Faces must remain realistic, highly recognizable, and consistent while rendered in a painterly illustration style.
SUBJECT & COMPOSITION
A cute couple stands closely together in an intimate pose.
Male (left): Slightly angled toward the woman, dark styled hair, neatly groomed beard (if present). He wears a dark charcoal blazer over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater.
Female (right): Facing the man, natural straight hair with subtle highlights. She wears a beige/tan trench coat over a black turtleneck. A simple silver or white-gold ring is visible on her ring finger.
Their foreheads gently touch, both smiling softly, expressing warmth, trust, and emotional closeness.
Each person holds one long-stem red rose, positioned symmetrically in the lower center of the frame. The roses are fully bloomed with rich red petals and natural green leaves.
Behind the couple is a large stylized red heart, centered and softly painted, acting as a visual halo and compositional anchor.
COLOR PALETTE & LIGHTING
Primary colors: Deep red, burgundy, beige, charcoal, and warm natural skin tones
Background: Off-white / light cream with a subtle cold-press paper texture, resembling a premium printed greeting card
Lighting: Soft directional light from the upper right, creating gentle highlights on faces and hair, with smooth, natural shadows
Mood: Warm, romantic, calm, emotionally inviting
ART STYLE & RENDERING
Semi-realistic digital painting with traditional media influence
The red heart shows visible brushstrokes and soft, painterly edges (watercolor/acrylic feel)
Faces rendered with high detail (skin transitions, hair strands)
Clothing rendered slightly smoother for balance
Clean, modern finish suitable for social sharing
4K resolution, semi-realistic style
TYPOGRAPHY & GRAPHIC ELEMENTS
At the top center, include the text:
“Happy Rose Day”
Elegant script font
Deep red / dark mahogany color
Fluid handwritten style with decorative flourishes on capital letters
Include a small watermark:
“@PromptPlum.com” with 50% opacity
Positioned subtly on the left side of the heart
SYMBOLIC & EMOTIONAL DIRECTION
Emphasize:

Love, affection, and emotional intimacy
Romance expressed through connection, not dramatic posing
A gentle, universal Valentine’s atmosphere
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
